title: Proofreading Tool — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Checks finished drafts for errors, inconsistencies, and formatting slips. The Proofreading Tool checks finished drafts for errors and inconsistencies. It runs a final pass over the whole document: spelling, punctuation, grammar, consistent terminology, heading levels, and citation formatting. It compares repeated terms and numbers across the draft and flags anything that changed halfway through.
capabilities: Check heading levels and document structure
Flag numbers and names that change mid-document
